name: Sérénité Esthetics Inc.
niche: Facial & skin care studio (also waxing, laser hair removal)
rating_source_note: Sourced from Fresha's own embedded location data (rating + reviewsCount, cross-checked against the individual verbatim review edges, all 5-star). Independent confirmation via a live Google Business/Maps card was attempted (direct Google Maps fetch, Google search, WebFetch) but no renderable Google listing surfaced through available tools (Google Maps requires client-side JS the sandbox fetch tools cannot execute). Site copy therefore cites Fresha explicitly as the rating source instead of claiming Google.
phone_source: Fresha location.contactNumber, matches the studio's own printed signage photographed in the gallery (assets/raw/se-signage.jpg, se-plaque-wide.jpg)
email_search_evidence: Fresha owner.onlineLinks: {facebookUrl: null, instagramUrl: 'https://www.instagram.com/sereniteesthetics', websiteUrl: 'https://www.tiktok.com/@serenite.esthetics'} - no email, no Facebook page
Instagram web_profile_info endpoint (x-ig-app-id 936619743392459): returned HTTP 400 (endpoint broken, matches known issue documented in FORGE-BRIEF.md)
Direct Instagram profile page fetch (curl + WebFetch): returned login-wall / 429 rate limit on every attempt, no bio/business_email visible
TikTok bio (@serenite.esthetics): bio text is just 'Make Your Day', no external link, no email

Search surfaced a Linktree for 'SerenityEsthetics' (similar name) - checked directly and confirmed it belongs to an unrelated esthetician (Kasmira Joseph), not this business. Discarded as a false match.
Florida Sunbiz corporate filing (registered agent Rosalie Chauvet, Pinecrest FL address): fetch blocked with HTTP 403 (WAF), and Sunbiz does not publish officer emails publicly in any case
Conclusion: no public email found after exhaustive search. Registered honestly as null, not fabricated. Outreach channel: phone or Instagram DM.

address_full.neighborhood_note: Fresha lists this as 'West End, Miami' / 'Calusa Area' / nearby 'The Hammocks'; commonly referred to as (West) Kendall.

hours.source: Fresha location.workingTime, matches the hours pre-verified from discovery research

language_note: Reviews, Fresha description and social captions are all in English. Business name is French ('Sérénité' = serenity) but used as a proper noun/brand only.
brand_vibe: Warm, quiet-luxury spa aesthetic: cream and white treatment rooms, soft warm lighting, a gold script logo/wordmark on the studio signage, neutral wood and rattan decor accents, fresh flowers in the hallway. Site built on the light-v2 base with a warm gold/champagne accent palette (hue ~40) derived directly from the business's own gold logo color, not invented.
has_own_site_evidence: sereniteesthetics.com: DNS ENOTFOUND (does not resolve) - confirmed at discovery stage
Fresha owner.onlineLinks.websiteUrl points to a TikTok profile, not a real domain, which Fresha uses as a fallback when no website is set
No Facebook page found (onlineLinks.facebookUrl is null)
Web search for the business name + address surfaces only Fresha, Sunbiz and directory listings, no independent business website
Conclusion: no website of their own. Sole online booking channel is Fresha.
about_source_text: Sérénité Esthetics Inc. offers a unique fusion of beauty and wellness, ensuring a transformative experience that leaves clients feeling refreshed and invigorated. With a focus on specialized skin care treatments, laser hair removal and full body waxing, this spa is dedicated to excellence and sustainability, making it a standout choice in Miami.

reviews_used_on_site.author: Geneviève A.
reviews_used_on_site.body: I always have an outstanding experience every time I get a facial here. I actually fly in from Tampa just to see her, that's how much I trust and value Rosalie work. The environment is clean, relaxing, and welcoming, and she is professional, kind, and attentive to my skin's needs. I truly appreciate the care and attention to detail during each visit. Highly recommended!
reviews_used_on_site.note: Original quote used an em-dash after 'see her'; normalized to a comma for site-copy compliance (no em-dash rule). No words changed or added.

photos_used.instagram_photos_note: 12 Instagram posts were also fetched via the ig_photos.py Railway service. Nearly all were promotional graphics with text overlays, gift-card ads, before/after close-ups of congested skin, or a caricature illustration, none met the gallery curation bar (no text overlays, no irritated skin, no graphics). None were used on the site; the Fresha venue/portfolio photos were higher quality and fully real (unstaged studio + treatment photos).
